description: The chart consists of three pie charts representing the distribution of difficulty levels in knowledge crosswords: easy, medium, and hard. Each pie chart is divided into four categories based on the presence of letters: N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-. The easy difficulty level has 40.6% N+K+, 3.3% N-K+, 45.9% N-K-, and 10.1% N+K-. The medium difficulty level has 44.6% N+K+, 3.9% N-K+, 44.3% N-K-, and 7.2% N+K-. The hard difficulty level has 36.2% N+K+, 20.1% N-K+, 36.8% N-K-, and 7.0% N+K-. The pie charts do not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered by size within each pie chart, with the largest segment being N-K- in the easy difficulty level, followed by N+K+ in the medium difficulty level, and N+K- in the hard difficulty level.
